titleStmt.title: List of the documents, books, maps, &c., delivered to the umpire in the territorial question between Paraguay and the Argentine Republic.

setting.placeName:
Legation of the Republic of Paraguay,
Washington

head.hi: List of the documents, books, maps, &c., delivered to the umpire in the territorial question between Paraguay and the Argentine Republic.

opener.dateline:
Legation of the Republic of Paraguay,
Washington, March 27, 1878.

list.item: Certified copy of the treaty of limits between Paraguay and the Argentine Republic of February 3, 1876.

Expediente (docket) designated as Exhibit C, containing 75 documents, copied from the originals in the archives of La Asuncion, compared by the minister of Italy near the Government of Paraguay, and duly authenticated.
Report of the minister of foreign affairs of the Argentine Republic for 1874.
Same for 1876.
Same for 1877.
Supplement to the report of the Brazilian minister of foreign affairs for 1875.
Original expediente (docket) formed in 1782, wherein appear the declarations of 30 witnesses concerning the towns, block-houses (redoubts), &c., possessed by Paraguay at that epoch.

Packet of papers, wherein are recorded the occurrences of the “Melodia “blockhouses, which existed where to-day stand La Villa Occidental, written by Father Amancio Gonzales Escobar, its founder and supporter.
“El Paraguayo Independiente,” two volumes.
The Rio de la Plata Review, vol. I.
History of the Province of Paraguay, Rio de la Plata and Tecuman, by Father Pedro Lozano.
History of Paraguay, by Don Feliz de Azára, two volumes.
Voyages in South America, by Don Feliz de Azára, four volumes.
Physical, Economical, and Political History of Paraguay, by Alfred Demersay, wo volumes.
The Republic of Paraguay, by Alfred M. du Graty, with a map at the end.
Modern Paraguay, by Benjamin Poucel.
Vattel, “Le Droit des Gens,” three volumes.
Bello, Principles of International Law.
A pamphlet containing the decree which created the colony known as Nueva Bordeos (New Bordeaux), afterward Villa Occidental.
A number of La Reforma, a daily paper published at La Asuncion, dated the 24th of November, 1877.
Two maps, one by Monchez, the other by Du Graty.
